name: Hero Chains of Destiny
storyline:
In a fantasy world filled with dangerous dungeons, powerful monsters, and untold treasures, adventurers gather together to form guilds in pursuit of wealth, glory, and survival.

Beginning with a small guild and a handful of heroes, players must recruit adventurers, collect powerful cards, and assemble teams capable of surviving the dangers that await beneath the surface.

Deep within the dungeons lie increasingly powerful creatures, ancient treasures, and legendary bosses. Rival guilds compete for riches, while unexpected encounters can change the course of an expedition.

Every journey carries consequences. Heroes can fall in battle, valuable equipment can be lost, and entire expeditions can end in disaster. Those who survive return with treasures and experience to help their guild grow stronger.

Through countless expeditions, victories, and defeats, players shape the legacy of their guild as they attempt to conquer the dungeon's deepest floors and forge their own destiny.
summary:
Hero Chains of Destiny is a fantasy dungeon-crawling, deck-building RPG developed by TavernCatGames. Players build and manage their own guild, collect cards, assemble a party of three characters, and venture into dangerous dungeons filled with monsters, treasure, and encounters.

Combat combines turn-based strategy with collectible cards, character abilities, equipment, summoned monsters, and a shared Power Stone resource system. Players can expand their collections through dungeon expeditions and card packs, experiment with different party and deck combinations, and challenge increasingly difficult enemies.

The game also features arena battles, multiplayer activities, card collection management, and optional town activities such as fishing and the Wheel of Fate.
